reviews.comment: Prof Kneitly is very invested in his students. He took the time to answer any and all questions, granted I had him for a small summer course, and is a funny guy who tries to make the content more enjoyable.

Very easy class and gives way less work compared to most professors. However, in my opinion, the class was far too simple and easy. That may be on the curriculum side and not the professor, but either way it had little challenge involved. Also had a subtle but strong liberal bias.

Attendance was mandatory and if you didn't show up enough he would fail you. That's at least what he said but he was extremely lenient. This professor was very nice and his class was actual quite interesting even though it was a low level class. There were some papers which were a lot of work, but that's just the nature of the class. Great prof.

Prof. Kneitly is awesome! Super kind guy and wants you to succeed. Go to class and you'll literally get an A. Loves group projects and gives you class time for everything, no exams. A couple papers to do but they're very clearly graded and he will give you feedback and grade pretty lightly. Take him!
